ls -d skills/review/phases 2>/dev/null && echo "repo-root skills present"; ls -d .prflow/vendor/prflow/skills/review/phases 2>/dev/null && echo "vendored present"; echo "---"; echo "$CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR"

for f in phase-1-setup phase-2-implement phase-3-review phase-4-documentation; do echo "== $f =="; python3 - "skills/implement/phases/$f.md" <<'PY'
import sys,re
t=open(sys.argv[1]).read().split('\n')
inb=False
for i,l in enumerate(t,1):
    s=l.strip()
    if not inb and s=='```bash': inb=True; continue
    if inb and s=='```': inb=False; continue
    if inb:
        if re.search(r'\$\(', l) or '`' in l or '$?' in l:
            print(i, l)
PY
done

for f in skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-implement.md skills/implement/phases/phase-3-review.md skills/implement/phases/phase-4-documentation.md; do
  echo "=== $f ==="
  grep -nE '\$\(|`|\$\?' "$f" | grep -vE '^\s*[0-9]+:.*(<!--|prflow:)' | head -20
done

for f in skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-implement.md skills/implement/phases/phase-3-review.md skills/implement/phases/phase-4-documentation.md; do
  echo "=== $f: command-subst / backtick / exit-status occurrences ==="
  grep -nF -e '$(' -e '`' "$f" | wc -l
  grep -noF -e '$?' "$f" | wc -l
done
